intent: Coordinate PID output to native hardware capability: binary duty cycling, percentage fan/valve control without double PWM, supported discrete speed levels, quiet sleep/occupancy caps; offer per-device Manual, IMC-Lambda, Cohen-Coon deterministic calibration selector with measured FOPDT model and explicit safe Apply action.
note: Pure model tuning never probes, oscillates, starts or physically calibrates appliances automatically. Model input changes alone do not alter Kp/Ki/Kd; Apply requires native physical output OFF, no owned power or pending command, and valid bounded gains. No vendor-specific workarounds.
changes: Per-device PID output allocator maps demand to real proportional speed or valid ordered discrete fan modes, while pure binary outputs retain protected duty cycle.
Standalone percentage fans never receive double PID PWM/percentage scaling; direct verified number valves retain gradual bounded modulation.
Quiet-room flags cap native fan output and unknown sleep/occupancy evidence holds speed and power-start decisions.
New per-device Manual / SIMC-IMC Lambda / Cohen-Coon PID calibration selector and four model parameters shown conditionally in Home Assistant and room dashboard.
Pure FOPDT tuning math converts known process gain, dead time and time constant to parallel Kp/Ki/Kd; rejects implausible or out-of-bound models without clamping or phantom hardware tests.
Explicit Apply calibration button requires PID selection, measured process model, physically OFF output, no owned power and no pending acknowledgement; never issues hardware service commands.
Expose read-only PID output strategy, calibration method and last applied input evidence per physical controller.
Provide all 38 translation catalog entries with reviewed English/Greek/German/French/Spanish calibration names and device-specific model controls.
Add deterministic tests for math, safe apply, authorization, staged/percentage fans, no double duty modulation, quiet caps, unknown occupancy and cross-room dashboard constraints.
Preserve prior beta31-39 behavior and one canonical environment_manager domain; only publish after Python 3.13/3.14, installed HA 2026.10, frontend/HACS/Hassfest and flat prerelease checks pass.
